$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNS (AIP France, chart dated 2024-10-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Sisteron-Thèze

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: Aerodrome reserved for home-based ACFT, gliding and service airplanes.
Available for helicopters under the conditions specified by DSAC-SE.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
ACFT: from 01/03 to 30/09, avoid departures and arrivals late in the morning, in the beginning and at the end of the afternoon, during heavy gliding activity.
Radio contact mandatory.
It is recommended to read "Special instructions LFNS" published on website: www.aerodrome-sisteron.com Priority at landing for gliders.
At TKOF and LDG, respect the road restriction 15 ft ASFC when overflying the secondary road located upstream THR 35.
Gliders paved strip 700 x 10 m reserved for gliders activity and for based ACFT out of gliders activity.
ZA31 parcel is located outside of movement area.
Taxiing of ACFT with running engine is prohibited.
Aerobatics on AD (NR 6911): 2450 ft AMSL - FL 065.
OCTFEB: SR-SS.
Self information on A/A FREQ.
Utilisable par les hélicoptères dans les conditions définies par la DSAC-SE.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Aéronefs : du 01/03 au 30/09, éviter départs et arrivées en fin de matinée, début d'après-midi et fin d'après-midi, pendant les périodes de forte activité vol à voile.
Contact radio obligatoire A/A.
Il est recommandé de prendre connaissance des "consignes particulières LFNS" publiées sur le site : www.aérodrome-sisteron.com Priorité aux planeurs à l'atterrissage.
Respecter au décollage et à l'atterrissage le gabarit routier de 15 ft ASFC, au passage de la voie de circulation située au seuil de piste 35.
Bande revêtue planeurs 700 x 10 m réservée à l'activité planeurs et aux ACFT basés en dehors de l'activité planeurs.
La parcelle ZA31 se trouve en dehors de l'aire de mouvement.
La circulation des ACFT moteur en fonction y est interdite.
Voltige sur AD (N° 6911) : 2450 ft AMSL - FL 065.
Auto-information sur FREQ A/A.
